findings.title: L400 retains the maker-land heel compromise

evidence.measured: Two 1.8x2.5mm lands at local x+/-2.35mm: inner edges+/-1.45mm, outer span6.50mm.

evidence.maker_page: SRP5030T p1, Recommended Layout/Product Dimensions; no revision printed on inspected page
evidence.measured: Maker recommendation2.0x1.8mm at+/-2.25mm. With body5.7+/-0.3 and terminal length1.1+/-0.3, an independent permitted corner has heel=5.4/2-1.4=1.30mm; native land begins1.45mm, leaving0.15mm possible heel strip.

findings.reason: Nominal termination contact remains covered; neither an open joint nor inadequate retention/current was demonstrated. This is a retained land/assembly qualification deviation, not a failed required function.
findings.concrete_fix: Qualify actual maximum-tolerance solder/heel coverage and retention with the assembler, or adopt the maker land in a separately covered generator revision and rerun the affected power/routing/fab checks.

findings.title: DB125 insertion-fit tolerance budget is not established by the nominal1.30mm hole

evidence.measured: All23 contacts:1.30mm native drill,1.90mm copper diameter,3.50mm pitch.

evidence.maker_page: DORABO T0-1 sheet1/1,2022-11-26: pin dimensions and general tolerance table
evidence.measured: Pin0.50x0.85mm, general untoleranced linear dimensions through6mm +/-0.20mm. A sharp-rectangle maximum is0.70x1.05mm, circumscribed diameter1.261942946mm. Maker separately recommends nominal1.20mm PCB holes.

evidence.maker_page: JLCPCB Drilling / Hole size Tolerance, accessed2026-10-30
evidence.measured: Standard finished through-hole tolerance+0.13/-0.08mm permits1.22mm from1.30mm nominal. Sharp-corner size-only allowance1.22-1.261942946=-0.041942946mm before position/pitch allowance.

findings.reason: This is an explicit worst-corner insertion-budget gap. The calculation assumes independent general tolerances and rectangular sharp corners; actual corner radii, pin stamping tolerances, lead compliance and seating are unmeasured. The maker1.20mm recommendation also prevents treating this envelope calculation alone as proof of an insertion failure. No Major/function failure is established.
findings.concrete_fix: Obtain an authoritative maximum circumscribed pin/pitch specification and assembler finished-hole/position allocation; record positive insertion clearance. If the current drill cannot meet that allocation, revise the generated terminal drills/lands under a covered CAD change while preserving annulus,1.5mm copper gap and all neighbouring clearances. Carry this specific fit check into first article.
